audit.why: Both layers already read Sion / Skill / Graves / Graves / Skill / Graves / Sion, matching the packet chart and a 49.06% Emerald+ win rate. The sides are right; only the full-layer phase whys were boilerplate that contradicted them (phases[0].why claimed 'four shells of buckshot win any level-1 face-off' under a Sion-sided row).
audit.corrected: Sides untouched; six phase whys rewritten so the text agrees with the side it sits under.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why described Level 6 as a Graves execute spike and phases[5].why as a generic wall-fight pattern, neither of which is the actual spike story on this page.
audit.why: Sion's 6 is Unstoppable Onslaught, 140/100/60s — at rank 1 that is a very long cooldown and adds tankiness more than lane kill pressure, so 6 is genuinely a skill window. Graves' real spike is the first item against a Sion still finishing his first tank item, and the play there is baiting Soul Furnace (15/14/13/12/11s) before committing.
audit.corrected: Both whys rewritten to the correct spikes, with the Soul Furnace bait named.

audit.whatIsWrong: Smoke Screen is described as a blind in four places — whys[2], spikes[1], early and wants.you[1] — all of them telling you the blind cancels his autos and his zombie-state chip.
audit.why: Riot text, Graves W: 'creates a cloud of smoke that reduces sight range. Enemies caught in the initial impact are dealt magic damage and have their Move Speed reduced briefly.' There is no blind. Glory in Death's rapid attacks are not stopped by it, so the page was promising a defence that does not exist against the exact thing it named.
audit.corrected: All four rewritten to the real effect: slow on impact plus a sight-range cut.

audit.whatIsWrong: Roar of the Slayer's armor reduction appears nowhere, while three separate fields tell you True Grit's armor stacking carries the extended trade.
audit.why: Sion E, 800 range, 8-12s: 'damages and slows and reduces the Armor of the first enemy hit. If the shockwave hits a minion or monster, it will be knocked back, damaging, slowing, and reducing the Armor of all enemies that it passes through.' He shreds the exact stat Quickdraw grants, from outside your shotgun range, and can do it through the wave.
audit.corrected: Added to early and to phases[3].why so the armor-stacking advice is honest about what it is worth.

audit.whatIsWrong: Decimating Smash was named as the matchup-defining cooldown on six fields with no number and no charge condition.
audit.why: Sion Q is 10/9/8/7/6s, and Riot's text is explicit: 'If he charges for enough time, enemies hit by the swing will also be knocked up and stunned.' A short release is damage only — the difference between a lost trade and a free one.
audit.corrected: Charge condition and 6-10s written into the cooldown block, dosFull[0], report[5] and phases[0].why.

edits.before: Four shells of buckshot win any level-1 face-off — trade autos point-blank where every pellet lands.
edits.after: One ability, no dash, and a charged Decimating Smash knocks you up the moment you step in to CS.

edits.before: E online — dash-reload weaving starts: auto, E for the grit armor and reset, auto again. Most champs lose this flat.
edits.after: You get a second ability but no combo yet, and his charged Q plus the Soul Furnace shield keep trades square.

edits.before: Full kit: Q's wall-bounce return is your real damage — fight near terrain so both hits connect.
edits.after: Full kit online — E in, unload the spread point-blank, and out-DPS a Sion who cannot disengage.

edits.before: Trade in shell rhythm: two autos and out. Track Decimating Smash (Stun); your armor stacks from E make his short trades unprofitable.
edits.after: Trade in shell rhythm: two autos and out. Roar of the Slayer shreds armor from 800, so True Grit blunts less of him than you think.

edits.before: Collateral Damage adds an execute and a disengage knockback in one — hold it for either, never for chip.
edits.after: Your R makes the all-in lethal, but his 6 is raw tankiness and a fresh shield still eats a full volley.

edits.before: First item spike — the point-blank Q-AA-E-AA pattern now removes half bars. Force fights near walls.
edits.after: First item spike — bait out the Soul Furnace shield with a Q poke, then E in the moment it is down.

edits.before: You out-skirmish but the crit scalers pass you — convert to picks with smoke-screen blinds and R snipes.
edits.after: Two tank items, and Glory in Death means even a clean kill buys you a zombie that keeps swinging.

edits.before: - Sion Decimating Smash (Stun): matchup-defining — Charged knockup — break the channel or sidestep the slam. It governs your forward steps. - E dash spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Sion Decimating Smash (Stun): matchup-defining — 6-10s, and it knocks up only if he charges it long enough; sidestep the arc. It governs your forward steps. - E dash spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.

edits.before: Charged knockup — break the channel or sidestep the slam. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: It knocks up only when charged long enough, 6-10s — sidestep the arc. Its cooldown is the green light.

edits.before: Track Sion’s Decimating Smash (Stun): Charged knockup — break the channel or sidestep the slam. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Track Sion’s Decimating Smash: it stuns only when charged long enough, 6-10s — sidestep the arc. The whole green-light system is that cooldown.

edits.before: Your W smoke blinds tower dives and breaks gank pathing — drop it on arrival and turn their 2v1 into a coin flip you win.
edits.after: Your W cuts sight range on tower dives and breaks gank pathing — drop it on arrival and turn their 2v1 into a coin flip.

edits.before: Yours — with Q, W and E online you E in for the point-blank shell spread and drop W to blind his auto and zombie-state chip, out-DPSing an immobile Sion.
edits.after: Yours — with Q, W and E online you E in for the point-blank shell spread and drop Smoke Screen to slow him and gut his sight range, out-DPSing an immobile Sion.

edits.before: Your kit comes online — E in for the point-blank 4-shell burst, drop W to blind so his next auto and zombie-state chip miss, and out-DPS an immobile Sion before he can W-shield and detonate.
edits.after: Your kit comes online — E in for the point-blank 4-shell burst, drop Smoke Screen so the slow and the sight cut keep him off you, and out-DPS an immobile Sion before he can W-shield and detonate.

edits.before: Drop W on him as you commit so the blind makes his auto and zombie-state chip whiff while you free-hit through the smoke
edits.after: Drop W on him as you commit so the slow and the sight-range cut stop him re-aiming a charged Q while you free-hit

edits.before: Sion owns the very first level — your kit is just the Q powder trail with no E dash to reposition, and his charged Q can knock you up the moment you step into your already-short shell range to CS, while his W shield eats your return poke. Don't walk into a fully-charged Q to last-hit; take the safe farm with the tip of your Q detonation and wait for level 3. The lane flips there: E in for the point-blank 4-shell burst, throw W on top of him so the blind cancels his auto and zombie-state chip, then E back out on your second charge before he can W-shield and detonate the AOE.
edits.after: Sion owns the very first level — your kit is just the Q powder trail with no E dash to reposition, and his charged Q can knock you up the moment you step into your already-short shell range to CS, while his W shield eats your return poke. Don't walk into a fully-charged Q to last-hit; take safe farm with the tip of your Q and wait for level 3. Watch his E as well: Roar of the Slayer shreds your armor from 800 and knocks a minion back through you, so True Grit blunts less than it looks. The lane flips at 3: E in for the point-blank burst, drop Smoke Screen to slow him, then E out before he can W-shield and detonate.

notes: Chart was already correct and left alone; the full layer's phase whys were generic Graves boilerplate that argued against their own side tokens, so they were rewritten rather than reflagged. The repeated 'W blind' claim was the worst error — four fields told the reader Smoke Screen would blank Sion's autos and his Glory in Death zombie attacks, and it does neither. Best addition: Roar of the Slayer reduces armor from 800 range and can be fired through a minion, which directly devalues the True Grit stacking that three other fields lean on.
